name: Heir to the Throne
descriptionTemplate: The {STR} scaling of {Soup Rains from Above} is increased by 100%, plus an additional 5% for every 1% Crit Rate from Vivian herself, her WoD, and her Covenant. {Whatever's at Hand} grants the selected Awakener +10% Temporary Crit Rate, plus an additional 0.3% for every 1% Crit Rate from Vivian herself, her WoD, and her Covenant. This effect is boosted by {Boiling Anger}.
